project.name: Stride - Premium Shoe Brand
project.summary: A modern frontend e-commerce website for a premium shoe brand featuring interactive product browsing, filtering, and cart functionality using mock data with localStorage persistence
project.purpose: Showcase and sell footwear products through an engaging, conversion-focused shopping experience
project.primaryGoal: Drive product purchases through seamless browsing, selection, and checkout flow

assumptions: Using mock data for products (no backend API required)
Cart functionality is client-side only using React state and localStorage
No real payment processing - checkout form collects information but doesn't process payments
Product images will use placeholder images from Unsplash or similar service
Shoes will be categorized by type (sneakers, boots, athletic, casual)
Tailwind CSS for styling with a clean, premium aesthetic

designSystem.artDirection: Quiet luxury aesthetic with generous white space, premium typography, and high-quality product photography. Focus on craftsmanship and material quality through subtle textures and refined details.

colorDirection.background: Clean white (#ffffff) with light gray sections (#f8fafc)
colorDirection.accent: Muted gold (#d4af37) for highlights and CTAs

designSystem.typographyDirection: Clean sans-serif (Inter or similar) with bold headings and elegant body text. Large headline typography for hero sections, comfortable line heights for product descriptions.
designSystem.layoutComposition: Asymmetrical grid with generous margins, clear visual hierarchy from hero to product cards, consistent rhythm between sections with alternating white and light gray backgrounds.
designSystem.surfaceTreatment: Subtle shadows on product cards, thin borders for form inputs, soft hover states with elevation, minimal gradient usage for premium feel.
motionAndInteraction: Subtle hover elevation on product cards
componentStyling: Clean buttons with medium border radius
Minimal input fields with bottom border focus
Sticky header with transparent to solid transition
designSystem.imagery: High-quality lifestyle and product photography with consistent lighting, clean white backgrounds for product shots, 16:9 aspect ratio for hero images, 1:1 for product thumbnails.

content.tone: Sophisticated yet approachable, emphasizing quality, comfort, and style

acceptanceCriteria: Product cards display image, name, price, and rating correctly
Search filters products in real-time as user types
Category filter shows only products from selected category
Product detail page shows all variants and allows size/color selection
Cart persists items in localStorage across page refreshes
Quantity controls update cart totals immediately
Checkout form validates all required fields before submission
Site is fully responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop
All interactive elements have proper focus states for accessibility

plan.architectureSummary: React + Mantine e-commerce architecture for Stride premium shoe brand. Uses Mantine's component system with centralized theme configuration. Implements client-side cart persistence via CartContext with localStorage. Product data stored in mockProducts.js, reusable content in siteContent.js. Page components in src/pages/ compose section components for modular development. Common components handle shared UI patterns (ProductCard, RatingStars). Product-specific components manage gallery, variants, and selection controls. Cart components handle item management and order summary. All components follow PascalCase naming with mobile-first responsive design.

files.responsibility: Centralized content including brand story, navigation items, newsletter copy, and static page content
Mock product data with images, prices, categories, sizes, colors, ratings, and descriptions for all shoe products
Mantine design tokens including slate gray primary palette, muted gold accents, typography scale, border radius, and component defaults for premium aesthetic
React context managing cart state with addItem, removeItem, updateQuantity actions and localStorage persistence
Utility function to format prices with currency symbol and proper decimal places
Helper functions for localStorage get/set operations with JSON serialization and error handling
Reusable product card component displaying image, name, price, rating, category badge with quick view and add to cart actions
Display star rating component accepting rating value and optional review count
Skeleton loading component for product grid and image placeholders during filtering
Empty state component for no search results or empty cart scenarios
Responsive navigation with logo, nav links, cart icon with item count, and mobile hamburger menu
Site footer with brand info, quick links, social icons, and newsletter signup
Product image gallery with main image display, thumbnail navigation, and hover zoom functionality
Product detail display with name, price, rating, description, and integrated selection controls
Size selection component with available sizes displayed as clickable buttons or chips
Color variant selector displaying color options as swatches with active state indication
Increment/decrement quantity buttons with min/max validation and immediate total updates
Individual cart item display with product image, details, quantity controls, and remove button
Order summary component showing subtotal, shipping estimate, tax, and total with checkout button
Hero banner with compelling headline, subheadline, dual CTAs, and featured shoe background image with smooth scroll
Category navigation cards for Sneakers, Boots, Athletic, Casual with images and product counts
Featured best-selling products carousel/grid with quick view modal integration
Brand narrative section with craftsmanship highlights and founder/brand values content
Email capture form with input field, signup button, privacy assurance, and success message handling
Filter controls including search input, category tabs, price range slider, and sort dropdown
Product listing grid displaying filtered products with loading and empty states
Home page composing HeroSection, FeaturedCategories, BestSellers, BrandStory, and NewsletterSignup sections
Products listing page with ProductFilters and ProductGrid sections for browsing all shoes
Individual product detail page with ProductGallery and ProductInfo sections for full product view
Shopping cart page displaying cart items and summary with checkout call to action
Checkout form page collecting shipping address, payment method, and displaying order summary
Main application entry composing page components within Mantine provider with CartContext wrapper

prompt: Create a frontend e-commerce website for a shoe brand. Add product cards, search, category filter, product details, cart, quantity controls, and checkout form using mock data. Use React, Tailwind CSS, and localStorage.
